source_clause: SHVS1. For Standard Heated/Vented seats a press of the heated seat button turns the seat on HI, the soft button highlights red and the control displays 2 arrows, HI and/or LEDs. The next button press sets the seat to LO, button remains highlighted and displays 1 arrow, LO and/or LED. The next press, turns the heated seat OFF, the button is no longer highlighted and 2 arrows are shown un-highlighted.
reasoning: 驗證目標：12.8（SHVS1）以三句定出 Standard 加熱座椅之三段循環（HI／LO／OFF）及其指示，三個 037 leaf 逐句對應。關鍵情境條件：起始 PC 取 **第八軸之 Standard 值**（字面即本節首句）；依 **R-C34** 三軸暴露 → 補，第十二軸亦補。為什麼這樣切：三段循環取狀態轉換法。刻意略過：**Standard 與 Multi-Level 之差別在段數（3 vs 4）與箭頭數（2 vs 3）** —— 兩者為第八軸之兩值，故 `12.1` 與本節非重複（見 `distinguishing_axis`）；ch11 無 Standard 之對造節（其 13 節皆為 Multi-Level 或方向盤／分區），此不對稱記於此。

distinguishing_axis.axis: profile §3.2 第八軸「Standard vs Multi-Level 座椅」之值（功能型）
distinguishing_axis.delta: 見 `12.1` 之 delta (一)：Standard 為三段（HI／LO／OFF）、箭頭 2 支，Multi-Level 為四段、箭頭 3 支 —— 同一功能在第八軸兩值上之陳述，`duplicate_of` 不填

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: comfort section 之 Standard 加熱座椅軟鍵
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section（6.3）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: **暴露 → 全數補（本組首次以排除式使用第十二軸）** —— 座椅控制位於 comfort category 之 Seats 分頁，2.1 使 tabs 於僅前排氣候之車輛不顯示
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（出處 2.14 C15，跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **排除補並逐條答（R-C36-1）** —— 逐條之答皆為 `no`：ch16 無加熱／通風座椅之行為節（僅 16.16 之座椅 off icon，其 leaf 已停下），見 DR #41 之形態

tcs.tc_title: A press of the standard heated seat button sets the seat to HI
tcs.test_item:
For Standard Heated/Vented seats a press of the heated seat button turns the seat on HI, the soft button highlights red and the control displays 2 arrows, HI and/or LEDs.

(The vehicle has Standard Heated/Vented seats; The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle; read the heated seat button and its control)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has Standard Heated/Vented seats (12.8)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle, for which the comfort tabs are not displayed (2.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the heated seat button in the comfort section
2. Read the heated seat button and its control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The heated seat is on HI
2. The button is highlighted red and the control displays 2 arrows, HI and/or LEDs

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節中僅 `16.16`（ICE15）提及座椅圖示（「Off icon of seats will depend on system configuration」，其 leaf `122-02` 已停下），**無一節定義加熱／通風座椅、加熱方向盤或座椅分區之按壓循環、層級呈現或其 popup**；故本條之 EMEA 排除**無 ch16 對造句可依**，屬 R-C36-1 之過嚴側（同 DR #41 之形態）

tcs.test_item_authored: The system shall on a press of the heated seat button turn the seat on HI, with the soft button highlighted red and the control displaying 2 arrows, HI and/or LEDs
